text:
Nora B: Heads-up: new hire hit streaming crash on first-run of sampleapp. Node SDK printed partial tokens then 'Error: unexpected end of stream'. Network had artificial 300ms jitter.

Ilya V: can you paste what the sampleapp received?

Nora B: pasted tail: 
``
data: {"id":"e1","chunk":"He"}

:

data: {"id":"e1","chunk":"llo"}


``
there's a lone colon line between writes.

Tariq H: colon-only lines are keepalives. We saw proxies coalescing writes so keepalive lands inside a JSON string boundary. SDK's reassembler treats blank line as event-end; keepalive inside should be ignored but our state machine currently flips to boundary.

Ilya V: quick mitigation: tolerate `:
` anywhere inside partial-data and don't treat it as a full delimiter. I'll put up a tiny patch.

Nora B: added small repro to sampleapp/tests/keepalive-split.test.js and pushed branch. CI run queued.

ci-bot: ci/sampleapp #129 started (branch: nora/keepalive-tolerance) :rocket:

Tariq H: follow-up: onboarding doc should mention running `tc` or using the included proxy shim. New hires kept hitting this and opened tickets.

Ilya V: also log lastEventId and last raw-chunk on parse error to speed triage.

Nora B: thanks, PRs incoming.
